Payment Of Compensation To (`Shauhada', Permanently Disabled Or Injured
Persons) Civil Armed Forces Rules 2006
Payment Of
Compensation To (`Shauhada', Permanently Disabled Or Injured Persons) Civil
Armed Forces Rules 2006
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 10th February, 2006]
S.R.O.95(1)/2006, dated 7-2-2006.---In exercise of
the powers conferred by section 26(b) of the Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959
(XXVI), section 21(2)(b) of Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (W.P. Ordinance
XIV), section 18(b) of the Pakistan Coast Guards Act, 1973 (XVII) and section
21(b) of North West Frontier Constabulary Act, 1915, the Central Government may
by notification in the Official 'Gazette, inter alia make rules for regulating
the classes and grades of; and the remuneration to be paid to, members of the
force and their conditions of service; and the Federal Government is pleased to
make the following rules, namely:‑
1. Short title, application and commencement.--(1) These rules may be called the
Payment of Compensation of ('Shauhada', Permanently Disabled or Injured
Persons) Civil Armed Forces Rules, 2006.
(2) They shall apply to the
personnel of the Civil Armed Forces governed by the Frontier Corps Ordinance,
1959 (XXVI of -1959), the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (W.P. Ordinance XIV
of 1959), Pakistan Coast Guards Act, 1973 (XVIII of 1973) and North-West
Frontier Constabulary Act, 1915, including Northern Areas Scouts, raised vide
raising Order No.2/3/2002-CAF F.Con, dated 31st October, 2003.
(3) These rules will be
applicable with effect from 11th Noyember, 2005.
2. Definitions.--(1) In these rules, unless there is anything
repugnant in the subject or context,--‑
(a)
"Act" means the Pakistan Coast Guards Act, 1973 (XVIII of 1973) and
North-West Frontier Constabulary Act, 1915;
(b)
"Award" means an award of compensation as mentioned in rule 3;
(c)
"Committee" means a Committee constituted under rule 6;
(d)
"Family" means and includes,
(i) the wife or
wives; and
(ii) the
legitimate children, parents, brother(s) or sister(s), unmarried and below 21
years of age residing with and wholly dependent upon a member of the CAFs, as
the case may be.
(e) "member
of the force" means any person, irrespective of his rank or status,
serving in the Civil Armed Forces;
(f)
"Ordinances" means the Frontier Corps Ordinance, 1959 (XXVI of 1959),
and the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959);
(g) "Serious
injury" means any injury entailing prolonged treatment or likely to have
adverse effect on body organs or their functioning; and
(h) "Shaheed"
means any member of the Civil Armed Forces, irrespective of his rank and
status, who is killed or dies due to any cause except suicide while on bona
fide Government duty.
(2) Words and
expressions used but not defined in these rules shall have the same meaning as
in the Act or Ordinances, as mentioned in Rule 2(1)(e)(t).
3. Award of compensation.---If
a member of the force is shaheed, permanently disabled, injured, serious or
minor, as the case may be while on bona fide Government duty, an award may be
granted to him or his family, as the case may be.
4. Preparation of cases for
award.--(1) The Unit
Commandant concerned shall prepare a statement of facts specifying therein the
circumstance under which the member of the force who lost his life in the
discharge of duty, was permanently disabled or injured, serious or minor, as
the case may be.
(2) In case of death of a member
of the force while on bona fide Government duty, a death certificate from the
authorized medical officer in this respect shall be prepared and enclosed with
the statement of facts prepared under sub-rule (1),k providing the following
information:
(a) particulars
of family member showing their ages, occupations and marital status; and
(b) where there
is no widow or children, particulars of parents of the shaheed member of the
